spec.description: Every Caltrans traffic camera in Los Angeles and Ventura counties as a wedge looking the way it points, with its live video beside the map, over the lane closures in force and the message signs, all from Caltrans' public feeds and reloaded every minute.

options.content:
### Los Angeles freeways, live: Caltrans cameras, lane closures and message signs

Every traffic camera **Caltrans** runs in **District 7** (Los Angeles and Ventura counties), drawn where it stands and looking the way Caltrans says it looks, over the **lane closures in force right now** and the **message signs** above the freeways. Everything is read live from Caltrans' public feeds: no key, no account.

- **Cameras**: blue wedges stream **live video**, amber ones a **still image** every two minutes, grey ones are out of service. Caltrans gives each view as north, east, south or west only, so a wedge is a sketch of where the camera looks, not a survey of its field of view.
- **Click a camera** to watch it beside the map, or pick one from **Camera** above. The video plays muted, about half a minute behind real time.
- **Lane closures**: red where a road or a ramp is shut, amber where lanes are. **Signs**: bright when showing a message, hover to read it.

The map, the closures and the signs reload every minute; the video never stops.

spec.rawSql:
-- Cameras by what they show, the closures in force and the signs in use.
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM $cameras WHERE status = 'Live video')         AS "Live video",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM $cameras WHERE status = 'Still image')        AS "Still image only",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM $cameras WHERE status = 'Out of service')     AS "Out of service",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM $closures WHERE closure = 'Full')             AS "Roads and ramps shut",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM $closures WHERE closure <> 'Full')            AS "Lane closures",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM $signs WHERE showing = 'Showing a message')   AS "Signs with a message"

-- Every camera, live video first. A row picks it and flies the map to it.
SELECT camera AS "Camera", route AS "Route", looking AS "Looking", status AS "Status",
       place AS "Near", latitude, longitude
FROM $cameras
ORDER BY status = 'Live video' DESC, status, route, camera

SELECT route AS "Route", direction AS "Direction", closure AS "Closure", facility AS "Where",

       work AS "Work", state AS "State", ends AS "Ends", latitude, longitude

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: every camera Caltrans runs in District 7 (Los Angeles and
-- Ventura), read through the gateway, which keeps the list a minute (see
-- gateway/feeds.conf). The images and the video are not read here: the
-- browser takes them straight from Caltrans.
-- Caltrans gives the view as North, East, South or West, never in degrees,
-- so each wedge is a sketch: that way, 60 degrees wide and 250 m long. A
-- camera with no direction is a small circle.
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT unnest(from_json((SELECT content FROM read_text('http://feeds/caltrans/d7/cctv/cctvStatusD07.json')),
                          '{"data": [{"cctv": {"location": {"locationName": "VARCHAR", "nearbyPlace": "VARCHAR", "longitude": "DOUBLE", "latitude": "DOUBLE", "direction": "VARCHAR", "route": "VARCHAR"}, "inService": "VARCHAR", "imageData": {"streamingVideoURL": "VARCHAR", "static": {"currentImageURL": "VARCHAR"}}}}]}').data).cctv AS c
)
SELECT c.location.locationName                          AS camera,
       c.location.route                                 AS route,
       c.location.nearbyPlace                           AS place,
       nullif(c.location.direction, '')                 AS looking,
       CASE c.location.direction WHEN 'North' THEN 0 WHEN 'East' THEN 90
                                 WHEN 'South' THEN 180 WHEN 'West' THEN 270 ELSE 0 END AS azimuth,
       CASE WHEN c.location.direction IN ('North', 'East', 'South', 'West') THEN 60 ELSE 360 END AS beamwidth,
       CASE WHEN c.location.direction IN ('North', 'East', 'South', 'West') THEN 250 ELSE 60 END AS range_m,
       CASE WHEN c.inService <> 'true' THEN 'Out of service'
            WHEN nullif(c.imageData.streamingVideoURL, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Live video'
            ELSE 'Still image' END                      AS status,
       nullif(c.imageData.streamingVideoURL, '')        AS stream_url,
       nullif(c.imageData.static.currentImageURL, '')   AS image_url,
       c.location.latitude                              AS latitude,
       c.location.longitude                             AS longitude
FROM feed
WHERE c.location.latitude IS NOT NULL

-- Server side: the lane closures in force in District 7 right now, out of the
-- 4,000 or so Caltrans lists for the coming weeks. In force: due to have
-- started and not yet over, and neither cancelled (code 1022) nor picked up
-- (1098). In place once the crew reports it set up (1097); until then, due.
-- One 14 MB file, kept five minutes by the gateway. A closure is drawn from
-- where it begins to where it ends, straight, up to 3 km: further, a straight
-- line would cut across the city instead of following the road, so only its
-- two ends are drawn.
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT unnest(from_json((SELECT content FROM read_text('http://feeds/caltrans/d7/lcs/lcsStatusD07.json')),
                          '{"data": [{"lcs": {"location": {"travelFlowDirection": "VARCHAR", "begin": {"beginLocationName": "VARCHAR", "beginLongitude": "DOUBLE", "beginLatitude": "DOUBLE", "beginRoute": "VARCHAR"}, "end": {"endLocationName": "VARCHAR", "endLongitude": "DOUBLE", "endLatitude": "DOUBLE"}}, "closure": {"closureID": "VARCHAR", "logNumber": "VARCHAR", "closureTimestamp": {"closureStartEpoch": "BIGINT", "closureEndEpoch": "BIGINT", "isClosureEndIndefinite": "VARCHAR"}, "facility": "VARCHAR", "typeOfClosure": "VARCHAR", "typeOfWork": "VARCHAR", "lanesClosed": "VARCHAR", "totalExistingLanes": "VARCHAR", "code1097": {"isCode1097": "VARCHAR"}, "code1098": {"isCode1098": "VARCHAR"}, "code1022": {"isCode1022": "VARCHAR"}}}}]}').data).lcs AS l
),
c AS (
  SELECT l.closure AS k, l.location AS w, l.location.begin AS b, l.location."end" AS e,
         l.closure.closureTimestamp AS t
  FROM feed
)
SELECT k.closureID || '-' || k.logNumber                AS closure_id,
       b.beginRoute                                     AS route,
       w.travelFlowDirection                            AS direction,
       b.beginLocationName                              AS from_place,
       e.endLocationName                                AS to_place,
       k.facility                                       AS facility,
       k.typeOfClosure                                  AS closure,
       nullif(k.lanesClosed, '')                        AS lanes_closed,
       nullif(k.totalExistingLanes, '')::INTEGER        AS lanes,
       k.typeOfWork                                     AS work,
       CASE WHEN k.code1097.isCode1097 = 'true' THEN 'In place' ELSE 'Due' END AS state,
       to_timestamp(t.closureStartEpoch)                AS starts,
       CASE WHEN t.isClosureEndIndefinite <> 'true' THEN to_timestamp(t.closureEndEpoch) END AS ends,
       (b.beginLatitude + e.endLatitude) / 2            AS latitude,
       (b.beginLongitude + e.endLongitude) / 2          AS longitude,
       CASE WHEN b.beginLatitude = e.endLatitude AND b.beginLongitude = e.endLongitude
            THEN '{"type":"Point","coordinates":[' || b.beginLongitude || ',' || b.beginLatitude || ']}'
            WHEN ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Point(b.beginLatitude, b.beginLongitude), ST_Point(e.endLatitude, e.endLongitude)) > 3000
            THEN '{"type":"MultiPoint","coordinates":[[' || b.beginLongitude || ',' || b.beginLatitude || '],['
                 || e.endLongitude || ',' || e.endLatitude || ']]}'
            ELSE '{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[' || b.beginLongitude || ',' || b.beginLatitude || '],['
                 || e.endLongitude || ',' || e.endLatitude || ']]}' END AS geom
FROM c
WHERE t.closureStartEpoch <= epoch(now())
  AND (t.isClosureEndIndefinite = 'true' OR t.closureEndEpoch > epoch(now()))
  AND k.code1022.isCode1022 <> 'true'
  AND k.code1098.isCode1098 <> 'true'
  AND b.beginLatitude IS NOT NULL AND e.endLatitude IS NOT NULL

-- Server side: the changeable message signs over the freeways of District 7,
-- and what each one shows. Kept a minute by the gateway. Most are blank;
-- the lines of a message are joined with a slash.
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT unnest(from_json((SELECT content FROM read_text('http://feeds/caltrans/d7/cms/cmsStatusD07.json')),
                          '{"data": [{"cms": {"location": {"locationName": "VARCHAR", "longitude": "DOUBLE", "latitude": "DOUBLE", "direction": "VARCHAR", "route": "VARCHAR"}, "inService": "VARCHAR", "message": {"display": "VARCHAR", "phase1": {"phase1Line1": "VARCHAR", "phase1Line2": "VARCHAR", "phase1Line3": "VARCHAR"}, "phase2": {"phase2Line1": "VARCHAR", "phase2Line2": "VARCHAR", "phase2Line3": "VARCHAR"}}}}]}').data).cms AS s
),
m AS (
  SELECT s, concat_ws(' / ', nullif(s.message.phase1.phase1Line1, ''), nullif(s.message.phase1.phase1Line2, ''),
                             nullif(s.message.phase1.phase1Line3, ''), nullif(s.message.phase2.phase2Line1, ''),
                             nullif(s.message.phase2.phase2Line2, ''), nullif(s.message.phase2.phase2Line3, '')) AS text
  FROM feed
  WHERE s.inService = 'true'
)
SELECT s.location.route || ' ' || s.location.direction || ' · ' || s.location.locationName AS sign,
       s.location.route                                 AS route,
       s.location.direction                             AS direction,
       CASE WHEN s.message.display = 'Blank' OR text = '' THEN 'Blank' ELSE 'Showing a message' END AS showing,
       CASE WHEN s.message.display <> 'Blank' THEN nullif(text, '') END AS message,
       s.location.latitude                              AS latitude,
       s.location.longitude                             AS longitude
FROM m
WHERE s.location.latitude IS NOT NULL
